changes.what: Dual paper portfolios + full JSONL logging + dashboard
changes.why: Isolate short (≤24h) vs long (≤7d) risk; full observability
Allow a few paper trades; diagnosis showed ≤7d books cluster at 0.99

changes.what_changed: Equal-share paper/live sizing; taker fee model (fee=shares×rate×p×(1-p)); min_net_edge=0.005 gate; completeness_arb resolve pays min(yes,no)*$1. Legacy open positions remain v0.1.1 equal-dollar.
changes.why: Equal-dollar YES/NO split → asymmetric payout (not a locked arb). Gross 0.99 edges often lose money after taker fees + spread.
changes.expected_effect: Fewer but fee-aware fills; same payout regardless of YES/NO win for new equal-share positions
changes.note_legacy: Existing open paper positions are v0.1.1 equal-dollar legacy; left open, not auto-closed

changes.what_changed: Multi-strategy paper system: sport_model + politics_news + maker_mm sleeves ($100 each) running in parallel with fee-aware arb short/long; strategy_id on all trades; dashboard tabs; maker mid-cross fills; rebate_estimate=0
changes.why: Extend beyond completeness arb into model-edge / info-edge / maker MM paper sleeves with honest v0 heuristics (not fake ML)
changes.expected_effect: Independent sleeve equities; more signal diversity; arb preserved; iterate heuristics via logs

changes.what_changed: Enforce maker max_open_positions on mid-cross fills; cancel excess resting quotes at/over cap
changes.why: Maker quotes placed under the open-position cap could still paper-fill after max was reached, growing maker open count past config (5→8)
changes.expected_effect: Maker open count never grows past max_open_positions; existing over-cap positions kept; excess open_quotes cancelled

changes.what_changed: Close paper positions when calendar end_date has passed (expired_calendar), even if book missing; keep price-based _looks_resolved
changes.why: Short NFL arb positions stayed open after end_date because mark_to_market only closed on extreme ~0/1 prices
changes.expected_effect: Past-end_date paper positions realize on next mark_to_market/scan using last marks or book mids; completeness_arb still pays shares*$1

changes.what_changed: Maker max_per_market=1 + prune_duplicates; edge-scaled sizing; long_max_hours=720; sport/politics min_edge=0.02; geopolitics fee_rate=0; sport_v0_dislocation heuristic
changes.why: Legacy equal-dollar arb realized -$0.27; maker stacked Fed markets blocking new quotes; sport/politics never filled at 3% min_edge; short-horizon arb often empty
changes.expected_effect: More paper fills with fee-aware long-tail arb + sport/politics at 2%; maker capacity freed; edge-scaled sizes concentrate on higher net_edge; measure realized P&L / open uniqueness / signal counts over 72h

changes.hypothesis: Stopping maker stacking + lowering sport/politics min_edge to 2% + 30d long arb bucket + fee-free geopolitics + edge-scaled sizing will increase paper (then live-eligible) profit vs v0.2.x
changes.change: maker.max_per_market=1; edge-scaled sizing; long_max_hours=720; sport/politics min_edge=0.02; geopolitics fee_rate=0
changes.expected_effect: More paper fills; freed maker capacity; better size on higher edge

changes.why: Free maker capacity: paper-close stacked duplicates on same market_id, keep earliest
changes.expected_effect: Maker open count drops to ≤1 per market; realized at mark; no auto-close of unique positions

changes.what_changed: Maker: no quotes/fills when hours_until(end)<6; skip extreme mids (<0.08/>0.92); defer expired_calendar binary wipe for unresolved single-side maker marks (warn + hold)
changes.why: Short-dated sports mid-cross fills (Alavés/Ipswich/Real Madrid) calendar-expired as full -$2 stake losses when marks stayed mid
changes.expected_effect: Stop short-dated sports maker adverse selection; fewer expired_calendar full-stake losses; realized P&L less crushed by lottery inventory

changes.what_changed: Never expired_calendar-wipe unless marks near 0/1 (all non-arb sleeves); prune inventory-neutral (pnl=0, excluded from win-rate); scan/dashboard premature_expired_calendar audit; correct Alavés/Ipswich/Real Madrid paper history
changes.why: v0.3.1 defer was maker-only and history still had mid-mark -$2 wipes (Real Madrid while live; Alavés actually NO-win); prune booked fake +$14 WIN
changes.expected_effect: No more premature sports calendar losses; maker realized matches legitimate closes; 15m scan notifies on premature_calendar flags

changes.what_changed: expired+near0/1 close reason → resolved; Real Madrid retag
changes.why: Correct settle was mislabeled expired_calendar after premature-wipe reopen
changes.expected_effect: Journals/dashboard show resolved for near-0/1 calendar settles; PnL unchanged

changes.what_changed: All sleeves including completeness arb defer calendar expiry while marks/book remain mid; only near-0/1 closes as resolved; reopen Fed 2252244/2252245 paper positions
changes.why: v0.3.3 exempted completeness arb, so the 2026-09-16 08:16 CEST scan prematurely closed two unresolved Fed arbs at mid marks
changes.expected_effect: No calendar-only close for any sleeve; unresolved arbs remain open and MTM until near-0/1 resolution

changes.what_changed: Replace politics sleeve with smart copy-trading of top Polymarket users (paper only)
changes.why: User request: strategy instead of politics; copy profitable ~90d leaders at $10 with drift gate
changes.expected_effect: copy sleeve signals/fills from public leaderboard+activity; politics disabled; maker/sport/arb unchanged
